instruction: Set the handheld round blue cup on top of the small drink-protecting wooden coaster.

source.instruction: Set the handheld round blue cup on top of the small drink-protecting wooden coaster.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the cup, which was at x = -18 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Pre-adjust the left gripper width to prepare for grasping the cup.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 25 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the cup; closed the gripper (opening 0.51: holding the cup)

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.51; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left gripper over the cup at (-21, 3, 94) and point downward.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+9, +22, -0) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the cup

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-21, 2, 94) opening 0.48; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper slightly by 2 cm along z to prepare for descent.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -2) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / +18 cm (vertical) from the cup

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-21, 2, 92) opening 0.48; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper into grasping position around the cup rim at z=82.5 and close gripper.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -10) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the cup; closed the gripper (opening 0.07: holding the cup)

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-21, 2, 83) opening 0.07; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift the cup by raising left arm 8 cm along z.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +8) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +9 cm (vertical) from the cup

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-21, 2, 91) opening 0.07; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move the cup above the coaster to roughly (-4, -7, 87) and adjust orientation.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+16, -9, -4) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the cup

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-5, -7, 87) opening 0.07; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Align slightly, lower the cup onto the coaster to z=85, and release gripper.
